morning.text: Seeing Perri’s expectant invitation, you decide to precariously maneuver your way across the bus to the seat they were patting.

morning.name: Perri
morning.text: Man, it feels like ages since we last rode the bus together. When I heard you were transferring to the same school as me from my mom, I made sure to save a seat for you at the back of the bus, just like in elementary.
The bus hits a small bump in the road, but being at the back of the bus, you feel the whole seat rock upwards. You feel yourself rising slightly from the seat as the chair catapults you up.
Wheeeee!
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: Only a few moments later, you and the bus both come plummeting back down to the usual height of the seat.
I haven’t sat in these seats of the bus since we started going to different schools. It just wasn’t the same. But, now that we’re back…
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: Perri looks at you with a bit of a mischievous grin.
Wanna compete again?
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: You remember the times from elementary when you and Perri would compete to see who bounced higher whenever the bus hit a bump in the road.
Considering the years that have passed since your last competition, you’ve grown taller and put on a bit more body mass.

morning.name: Perri
morning.text: Meanwhile Perri still looks as light as a feather compared to others around their age.

options.text: "Hard to compete with the equivalent of a stick bug."

morning.text: You look ahead and see that the bus is approaching a speed bump. Glancing at the driver, the old man piloting the vehicle shows no sign of slowing the bus down.
You curl up and hold your knees in a fetal position. Not really sure what it would do to help, you just remember always doing it when you used to compete with Perri.
Ha, you think rolling up like a cannonball is going to help you win?
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: Perri mocks as they also join you in bracing their knees to their chest.
As the bus zooms over the speed bump, you feel the seat pushing up against you.
You feel a sense of weightlessness as you lift up and away from the seat cushion.
THUNK
Only a few moments later, the feeling of gravity returns to you as you return back to the comfort of being grounded on the seat.
You turn to see where the thunk sound came from.
Owowowwowo
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: Perri’s busy rubbing the top of their head with their hand.

morning.name: Perri
morning.text: Ouch… Since when did the back of the seats in front of us feel like bricks…
They turn back to you and flash a smile.
Oh! Don’t worry, I’ll be alright.
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: Buuuut, I guess that makes me the winner!
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: Their smile beams

morning.name: Perri
morning.text: Thanks for playing with me again. It’s been too long since the last time we hung out.
Hey! Who are you calling a bug!
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: Perri laughs along with your jest and punches lightly on your shoulder.
And if anything, you’re the one who used to look like a stick bug.
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: I swear, you must’ve weighed less than me back in elementary.
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: Suddenly, you feel your seat jump up. Before you can grab anything to brace yourself with, the seat has already thrown you up with it
There was never a chance to get your balance before you felt yourself hurling forward into the seat in front of you.
THUNK THUNK
Your head hits straight into the seat back in front of you.
Despite looking cushioned, you can feel that it's a clear deception for the pile of bricks that it feels like it's made out of.
As you feel the return of the seat cushion’s comfort below you, you look over to Perri to check that they're okay while rubbing your own head to soften what might be a bruise.
Owowowwowo
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: Perri’s busy rubbing the top of their head with their hand.
Ouch… Since when did the back of the seats in front of us feel like bricks…
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: They turn back to you with a look of concern.
Are you alright? Did you hit your head hard? I- I can take you to the nurse’s station when we get to campus.
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: You nod your head while waving your other hand.
It’s best to not hassle Perri with taking you to the nurse’s station – it's probably just a bruise anyway.
Plus, you don’t want to be late on your first day nor make Perri late to their class.
A-alright then… make sure you ice it when you get home! Or you know what, I’ll come over after school and make sure it's iced!
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: You look ahead and see that the bus is approaching a speed bump.
Glancing at the driver, the old man piloting the vehicle shows no sign of slowing the bus down.
Quickly, you grab the seat to brace yourself down.
As the bus zooms over the speed bump, you feel the seat pushing up against you.
You grip tighter to hold yourself from flying off the tiny semblance of a cushion.
You look over to Perri where your gazes meet. Their smile from before disappears in exchange for a frown.
The bus, now having passed the speed bump, settles back down. Perri’s frown remains as their gaze moves downward.
It hasn’t been that long, has it? You didn’t use to be such a killjoy…
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: You don’t know how to respond to that. Afterall, who knows if you could’ve gotten hurt because the bus driver didn’t slow down for a speed bump.
Well, it’s whatever! We’ll be arriving at school soon, so I’m sure there’ll be other things we can do together.
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: Perri’s expression seemed to change back to normal, with her usual carefree smile plastered across her face.
We will be arriving at Sintax Academy very shortly! Please remain in your seats for the time being!
morning.name: Bus Driver

morning.text: Moments later, the bus pulls up to the entrance of the school.
It is a grand school, with mixes of Art-Deco and modern architecture blended in, evident with the old-school main building and the recently renovated science buildings.
You reach into your bag and dig around to pull out a crumpled paper. After un-crumpling it, Perri peers over your shoulder to take a peek at the contents of the paper.
Oh! Is that your schedule? Lemme see!
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: You angle the paper so that both of you can view it together.
Aww man, I don’t share a class with you until second period.
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: Do you think you can find your way to chemistry class on your own?
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: While reading closer in order to see the class room number, you nod your head in response to Perri’s question.
Afterall, you’re not in elementary school anymore; you now understand that rooms are (generally) numbered logically. It shouldn’t be too difficult to navigate the halls.
A-alright then. I guess I'll see you later in history class.
morning.name: Perri

morning.text: Perri gathers their things and gets up to head out of the bus. They turn to wave before stepping out.
For a split second, you could’ve sworn there was a small frown on her face as she turned back towards the school.
Regardless, it's time for you to start heading to class. Since you don’t know where it is yet, it's best to reserve time to search for the classroom.

history.text: You approach Perri who remains still staring out the window, as if unaware that class started.
You notice a rhythmic rise and fall of their shoulders. Looks like they fell asleep before class even started. Some things never change.
history.name: Perri

history.text: Class has started already so I should probably wake them up.
You take the seat next to Perri. You poke them lightly.
They’re still asleep. You try poking them a little harder.
They rustled in their sleep. Progress. It's time for the finishing move.
You grab onto their shoulders and shake them violently until they wake up.

history.name: Perri
history.text: WAaaaaAAaAaAaaAaAAaa!
They yelp while bobbing back and forth. Your work here is done, so you let go.
The outburst of noise has everyone in the class look over in you and Perri’s direction.
While their looks revealed a small sense of curiosity, no one seemed all that surprised about Perri waking up with a start in the middle of the class.

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Well, good morning Perri. It’s pair up time. Spend the next few minutes getting to know your partner.

history.name: Perri
history.text: Huh? Getting to know him? But I already do!

history.name: Perri
history.text: I guess I’m so productive in my sleep that I already finished the assignment.
Perri says with a proud smile beaming across their face.
They turn their attention back towards you.

history.name: Perri
history.text: Yay! We get to be partnered.

history.name: Perri
history.text: It makes me glad that you woke me up. I’d trade sleep for more time with you any day.
Perri appears giddy with enthusiasm.

history.name: Perri
history.text: Since we already know each other so well, let’s just chat about whatever! I’m sure Professor Hermit won’t mind at all.
You glance over and see Professor Hermit peering back. He doesn’t seem bothered by Perri’s assumption… maybe?
sigh
They probably didn’t get enough sleep last night.
Maybe a late night cramming in some extra studies in preparation for class.
That, or a late night playing games or watching anime.
The latter is definitely more likely.
You take a seat at the desk in front of Perri such that your body blocks the direct line of sight from the professor to Perri.
It’s not your first rodeo covering for Perri’s impromptu nap times. You’ve garnered quite a bit of experience in pretending to partn–

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Perri! Wake up. You have a partner now so start your introductions
The professor saw right through your cover up.

history.name: Perri
history.text: H-huh!? P-partner?
They jump up and stare blankly at you. You stare back with a smile and a wave.

history.name: Perri
history.text: Oh it's you!
Their shocked stare turns into a smile.

history.name: Perri
history.text: Since it's you, I wouldn't have minded being woken up from my rejuvenation nap, you know.

history.name: Perri
history.text: That way, I get to spend more time with you.
They lean in a little closer towards you.

history.name: Perri
history.text: uhhh… What are we doing again?

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Introductions, Perri. We are doing partner introductions.
Despite Perri’s quiet whisper, the professor appears to have heard them loud and clear.

history.name: Perri
history.text: Oh, then it's a good thing we’re partners then. We know each other so well by now that we don’t need to do any introductions!

history.name: Perri
history.text: So!
They say while clapping their hands audibly enough that every other partnered group turns towards you two for a second before returning to their own discussions.

history.name: Perri
history.text: What have you been up to lately?
You shrug.

history.name: Perri
history.text: You haven’t invited me over lately so I’ve been completely out of the loop.

history.name: Perri
history.text: Any new games to play together? Not that I’ve ever been any good… but I’ve been practicing! I bet now I’ll have a better chance.
You remember how you always beat them at Super Shape Bros Ultim–

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Alright class, attention back to the front. Now that you’ve all paired up and introduced yourselves, how about a fastball trivia.
The professor cuts in.

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Perri, you first. In the Great Shape War, what was the reason behind the start of the war?

history.name: Perri
history.text: H-huh? Oh, uhh.. Well, it's.. Ummm…

history.name: Perri
history.text: Perri trails off without answering the question. They look at you with pleading eyes. Better help them out, you think to yourself.

options.text: Whisper that they should have studied a little harder
Whisper that the answer is territorial expansion
Whisper that the answer is The Artifact

history.name: Perri
history.text: Heyy.. That's not helping!
You shrug. Perri begins to frantically sift through all their papers as if they might have it written down somewhere.
It’s too bad that Perri has never been one to ever take notes, let keep any from previous classes.

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: It's a speed trivia. Emphasis on speed. You all should know this by heart.

history.name: Perri
history.text: By heart… right… and my heart is telling me…
Their eyebrows furrow and slightly lower. Their lips and fists clench tightly. It seems that Perri is focusing with all their might.
You hear a low growling sound from Perri’s direction.

history.name: Perri
history.text: Then, my heart tells me that the shapes were fighting because they were really hungry.
It seems all of Perri’s focus was wasted on their hunger instead.
You stifle a laugh.
According to your knowledge of video games, anime, and specifically isekais, you figured that most wars start over resources.

history.name: Perri
history.text: Oh right! The answer is territorial expansion!

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Ah, yes that could be a common misconception. Territorial expansion often happens as a result of wars.

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: But usually, as is the case with this one, a particular resource is sought after.

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Do you know what that resource might be? I’ll give you a hint: It’s so exclusive that there’s only one!
Perri thinks to themself for a moment, before the silence of their thought is interrupted by a low growling sound.

history.name: Perri
history.text: Eheh… It must’ve been the greatest, most magnificent, bestest snack to ever exist!
Professor Hermit sighs.
Perri stands up confidently and replies.

history.name: Perri
history.text: The answer is that the war was started over The Artifact.
They say with strong conviction.

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Correct!

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: When the artifact was discovered, the world quickly realized that whoever controlled the artifact controlled the shape kingdom.

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: One shape would have power over all the others. The world would be left in imbalance.
Yeah so what?
history.name: King Circle

history.text: The student in blue cuts in.
With the artifact, whoever rules would be able to do whatever they want. Don’t people say history is written by the victors anyways?
history.name: King Circle
Perri
history.text: But if no one controls The Artifact, then all the shapes can get along! We can all eat together and have fun together.

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Regardless of beliefs, still, good job studying up on the Great Shape War.
The professor looks directly at you after Perri’s response. I guess you weren’t very discreet when Perri asked for your help.

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Well, Perri, I’m glad that you're getting along with the new student paired with you, but next do try for yourself first.

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Don’t be afraid to answer wrong. If you become paralyzed by the fear of answering incorrectly, you’ll never progress through.

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Your learning, I mean.

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Even if you answer wrong, there’ll be an opportunity to learn for next time.
The class continues at a usual pace. The professor goes around the room asking different students different questions.
RING RING RING RING
Almost as soon as the first ring started, King Circle had already gotten out from his desk and headed towards the door.

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Now hold on there. Let me remind you: the bell does not dismiss you. I do.
Professor Hermit speaks with a smirk across his face.
Perri turns to you and whispers in your ear.

history.name: Perri
history.text: That's classic Professor Hermit for you. He really loves egging on students who rush to lunch.

history.name: Perri
history.text: Oh and speaking of lunch, come see me during lunch. I packed some extra snacks for us!

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Alright class, you are all dismissed!

history.name: Professor Hermit
history.text: Oh, and Perri, go to sleep early tonight. Snoozing should be done at the comfort of your bed, not on the desks of my class.

history.name: Perri
history.text: Yes, Professor.
Before they leave the room, Perri turns back and waves to you. Then they skip off towards the lockers, probably to retrieve their extra snacks.
You then also navigate your way to the cafeteria for lunch.

lunch.text: This will load the boss scene
